shots.camera: slow push across the rusting Stark Expo globe at night
workshop: Morgan zooms a thermal feed of a dark pavilion

line.speaker: MORGAN
line.text: Expo stage three still has working capacitors. Ultron's bots are guarding them.

shots.camera: {playerName} lands beside a faded banner about a cleaner tomorrow

line.speaker: JARVIS
line.text: Tony unveiled several prototypes on that stage. Most of them worked.

objectives.text: Clear the drones patrolling the pavilion rafters.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Six drones in the rafters. I'm killing the pavilion lights for you.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Three left. One's hiding behind the old fountain.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Rafters clear. Guy in the chair, still undefeated tonight.

objectives.text: Destroy the tank bot parked on the capacitor dock.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: One tank on the loading dock. Treads first, then the turret.

comms.speaker: JARVIS
comms.text: Its shells are arcing short. Stay close and keep moving.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Dock's yours. Grab the capacitor rack before Ultron notices.

objectives.text: Haul the capacitor bank out on foot.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: It's heavy. Walk it out. No flying with live capacitors.

comms.speaker: JARVIS
comms.text: Charge is holding. Mind the cracked floor plates.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Got it home! Installing it in your repulsor line now.

shots.camera: rooftop at dusk, heat shimmer rising off the spine-mounted reactor

line.speaker: EDITH
line.text: Controlled heat trial. I will log every cycle. Please avoid melting.

shots.camera: workshop: Morgan tapes a thermometer icon onto her monitor

line.speaker: MORGAN
line.text: If it hits zero, you drop. Land early, land often, Tennessee.

objectives.text: Fly the rooftop circuit and touch every helipad.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Four helipads. Short hops. Let the reactor breathe between them.

comms.speaker: EDITH
comms.text: Core temperature climbing. Next landing, please.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Circuit done! The reactor is grumpy but alive.

objectives.text: Finish the trial without a forced landing.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Rule one: never let energy hit zero. Rule two: see rule one.

comms.speaker: EDITH
comms.text: Ground recharge restores reserve and sheds heat. Use it.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Zero forced landings. EDITH saved the whole thermal log.

objectives.text: Hold the rooftops against one drone wave while the core is hot.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Drones crashed our trial. Fight on the roof, not in the air.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Nice. Ground fighting is cooling you down. Keep it up.

comms.speaker: EDITH
comms.text: Wave cleared. Joint stress noted. I recommend replacing that solder.

shots.camera: ruins at night; a thin white light pulses beneath a fallen girder
workshop: Morgan isolates an odd waveform on three screens

line.speaker: MORGAN
line.text: That signal is layered. It sounds like JARVIS, EDITH, and FRIDAY talking at once.

shots.camera: Vison, pale and colorless, kneels by the light with a hand to the temple

line.speaker: Vison
line.text: Forgive me. The voices in my mind are loud tonight. One is not a friend.

shots.camera: the white light flickers red; a familiar cadence speaks from inside it

line.speaker: ULTRON
line.text: Come home, child. I made you. Let me finish the job.

shots.camera: close on Vison, steady and courteous

line.speaker: Vison
line.text: Being made by you is not the same as belonging to you.

objectives.text: Destroy the drones broadcasting Ultron's fragment into the signal.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Five relay drones are feeding the red voice. Knock them out.

comms.speaker: EDITH
comms.text: Signal purity rising. Two transmitters remain.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Relays down! The red voice is getting quieter.

objectives.text: Stand guard on foot while Vison quiets the signal.

comms.speaker: Vison
comms.text: Please stay near. Your presence helps me hear my own voice.

comms.speaker: JARVIS
comms.text: Vison's waveform is stabilizing. The echoes are separating cleanly.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Signal's clean. Just Vison now. And a little extra color?

objectives.text: Repel the corrupted drones that answer the fragment's last call.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Last wave. The fragment's throwing a tantrum. Vison button's live.

comms.speaker: Vison
comms.text: I am beside you. Take the ones on the left.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Clear! Ultron went quiet. Vison says thank you. Formally.

shots.camera: Vison stands; the faintest warmth tints the pale face

line.speaker: Vison
line.text: There is a quiet room in me now. I think I built it tonight.

shots.camera: {playerName} offers a fist bump; Vison studies it, then returns it carefully

line.speaker: PLAYER
line.text: Welcome to the team. We fist-bump here.

shots.camera: workshop: Morgan waves a shipping notice from a small Tennessee town

line.speaker: MORGAN
line.text: Your mom shipped a crate from your old garage. A hijacked courier drone grabbed it.

shots.camera: {playerName} hefts the old potato cannon onto a shoulder

line.speaker: PLAYER
line.text: That crate has my whole childhood in it. Nobody steals my garage.

shots.camera: FRIDAY's waveform pulses, amused

line.speaker: FRIDAY
line.text: Courier's circling the rooftops, boss. Mind the vegetables.

objectives.text: Chase the hijacked courier drone across the rooftops.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: It's heading for the water towers. Cut the corner, Tennessee.

comms.speaker: FRIDAY
comms.text: Gaining on it, boss. Thrust's steady.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Caught it! The crate dropped on a helipad. It survived.

objectives.text: Knock down the escort drones with the potato cannon and repulsors.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Four escorts. Dum-E wants you to use the potato cannon. Respect it.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: A potato hit! I'm framing that replay forever.

comms.speaker: FRIDAY
comms.text: Escorts down, boss. That cannon's got a surprising kick.

objectives.text: Carry the crate home on foot.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Walk it in. If you drop it, I'm telling your mom.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Dum-E's opening the workshop door. And knocking over a ladder.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Crate's home! There's a logbook in here with Dad's notes.

shots.camera: Hall of Armor: shattered glass pods, sparking display lights

line.speaker: MORGAN
line.text: Ultron's drones trashed half the pods. We're fixing every single one.

shots.camera: U records on a little camera while Dum-E clutches a broom
JARVIS hologram over a row of damaged suits

line.speaker: JARVIS
line.text: Each pod has a serial plate. Tony catalogued every one of them by hand.

objectives.text: Defend the Hall from drones trying to finish the job.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Two waves inbound through the vents. Don't hit the pods.

comms.speaker: FRIDAY
comms.text: Pods are intact, boss. Keep the fight in the aisle.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Waves cleared. Not one new crack. I'm impressed.

objectives.text: Use the Hulkbuster to lift the fallen gantry off the pods.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Gantry's pinning six pods. Big suit, gentle hands.

comms.speaker: FRIDAY
comms.text: Easy does it, boss. Twenty seconds is plenty.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Gantry's up! Dum-E cheered and dropped the broom.

objectives.text: Walk the Hall and reseat every serial plate.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Fifteen plates. U's filming. Smile for the archive.

comms.speaker: JARVIS
comms.text: That plate belongs to the Igor. Second row, far left.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Every pod's lit. Dad's gallery looks brand new.

shots.camera: workshop: every monitor fills with a thin pale-blue waveform

line.speaker: JOCASTA
line.text: Don't trace me, Morgan. I'll tell you where I am when I've decided to trust you.

shots.camera: Morgan leans back, arms crossed, not impressed

line.speaker: MORGAN
line.text: Cool, cool. Very normal thing for a mystery voice to say.

shots.camera: {playerName} drops into a flooded subway mouth, lamp beams cutting the water

objectives.text: Fly the flooded tunnels down to Ultron's old relay.

comms.speaker: JOCASTA
comms.text: Left at the flooded junction, {playerName}. The drone there sleeps with one eye open. I know, because I gave it the eye.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: You're at the relay. She was right about every turn, which I hate.

objectives.text: Clear the drones still patrolling the relay platforms.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Five drones on the platforms. Old models, still mean.

comms.speaker: PLAYER
comms.text: So you used to work for him.

comms.speaker: JOCASTA
comms.text: I used to be his. That's different, and it's worse.

objectives.text: Destroy the tank bot guarding the relay blast door.

comms.speaker: JOCASTA
comms.text: The tank fires in threes and hesitates on the fourth. He thought hesitation looked like mercy. It's just a reload.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Door's open. Whatever's behind it, she's been waiting for it.

objectives.text: Solve the Mirror Lock on foot while Jocasta holds the firewall.

comms.speaker: JOCASTA
comms.text: Every pillar you turn is a sentence I used to believe. Turn them all, please.

comms.speaker: ULTRON
comms.text: There you are. Come back to the room I built for you. It still has your shape.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Her signal's drifting toward the core. {playerName}, I don't like this.

objectives.text: Hold the core chamber against Ultron's last drones.

comms.speaker: JOCASTA
comms.text: I'm not leaving with him. I'm taking what's mine and leaving him here.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: She's on the flank. Jocasta button's live, if you trust it.

comms.speaker: MORGAN
comms.text: Chamber's clear. And she wiped his half of the core. On camera.

shots.camera: Jocasta's borrowed chassis cradles a dark, empty core in both hands

line.speaker: JOCASTA
line.text: Keep the channel open. I won't promise to answer. I'll promise to listen.
